name: speckit-product-forge
description: Full product lifecycle orchestrator for SpecKit: research → product-spec → plan → tasks → implement → verify → test → release, across express/lite/standard/v-model modes with human-in-the-loop gates, cross-artifact sync-verify, a living/delta spec with a REQ→…→TEST→EVT traceability matrix, a feature catalog with deterministic retrieval, --dry-run previews, cross-model code review, and brown-field backfill.
